title: Compliance Monitoring
summary: Watches regulatory sources and internal control status in parallel: maps new or changed regulations to the controls they touch, collects evidence of control operation on schedule, and flags gaps with owners and deadlines — so audit prep becomes reviewing a living record instead of a quarterly archaeology dig.
review_rationale: Regulatory-change interpretations are drafts until compliance staff confirm applicability.

steps.name: watch_sources
steps.goal: Poll regulatory feeds and internal control systems in parallel.

steps.name: map_to_controls
steps.goal: Link each regulatory change to affected controls and policies.

steps.name: assess_impact
steps.goal: Draft an applicability and impact assessment for compliance review.

steps.name: collect_evidence
steps.goal: Gather scheduled control-operation evidence from source systems.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Approve the gap items and published evidence index before they reach owners and the audit record.

steps.name: flag_gaps
steps.goal: Open gap items with owner, severity, and remediation deadline.

steps.name: report
steps.goal: Publish the compliance dashboard data and audit-ready evidence index.

outputs: Gap register with owners and due dates
success_metrics: Days from regulation change to assessed impact

title: Contract Review
summary: Reviews inbound contracts clause-by-clause against your negotiation playbook: segments the document, analyzes clauses in parallel against standard positions, scores deviations by risk, and drafts redlines with fallback language — producing a counsel-ready markup instead of a cold read.
review_rationale: Counsel reviews all risk scores and redlines; nothing is sent to a counterparty without sign-off.

steps.name: parse_contract
steps.goal: Extract and segment the document into typed clauses.

steps.name: parallel_clause_analysis
steps.goal: Compare each clause against the playbook position concurrently.

steps.name: score_risk
steps.goal: Rate deviations by severity and business impact for this deal's context.

steps.name: draft_redlines
steps.goal: Draft markup with primary and fallback language per flagged clause.

steps.name: self_check
steps.goal: Verify every redline cites the actual contract text; drop unsupported flags.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Deliver the package to counsel for review and sign-off.

success_metrics: Deviation catch rate vs. counsel baseline

title: Expense Report Processing
summary: Turns a shoebox of receipts into a filed, policy-checked expense report: extracts merchant, amount, and category from receipt images, validates each line against expense policy, flags violations with the specific rule cited, and submits the clean report for approval.
review_rationale: Policy-clean reports auto-submit; flagged lines route to the employee, then the approver.

steps.name: ingest_receipts
steps.goal: Collect receipts from upload, email forward, or photo.

steps.name: extract_fields
steps.goal: Pull merchant, date, amount, currency, and line items from each receipt.

steps.name: categorize
steps.goal: Assign expense categories and cost centers per company taxonomy.

steps.name: policy_check
steps.goal: Validate each line against policy; attach the cited rule to any flag.

steps.name: route_exceptions
steps.goal: Return flagged lines to the employee with a plain-language fix.

steps.name: submit
steps.goal: File the completed report into the approval chain and confirm.

title: Invoice ↔ PO Matching (Three-Way Match)
summary: Automates the three-way match: extracts fields from incoming invoices, retrieves the corresponding purchase order and goods-receipt records, verifies quantities, prices, and terms across all three, and routes clean matches to payment while flagging exceptions to a human queue with a precise discrepancy explanation.
review_rationale: Clean in-tolerance matches post automatically; every exception requires human disposition.

steps.name: ingest_invoice
steps.goal: Capture the invoice and extract vendor, lines, quantities, prices, terms.

steps.name: fetch_records
steps.goal: Retrieve the referenced PO and goods-receipt records from the ERP.

steps.name: three_way_match
steps.goal: Compare invoice, PO, and receipt line-by-line against tolerance rules.

steps.name: route_exceptions
steps.goal: Send clean matches to payment; route discrepancies with explanations to the AP queue.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: AP specialist dispositions exceptions; decisions feed back into tolerance tuning.

steps.name: post_and_log
steps.goal: Post approved invoices and write the complete match audit record.

inputs: ERP access: POs and goods receipts

title: Meeting Scheduler
summary: Handles the scheduling volley end-to-end: parses the request, checks all attendees' availability, proposes ranked slots that respect working hours and time zones, negotiates via email or chat when calendars conflict, and books the final slot with the right room or link attached.
review_rationale: Internal meetings book automatically; external-attendee emails require approval on first contact.

steps.name: parse_request
steps.goal: Extract attendees, duration, urgency, and hard constraints.

steps.name: fetch_availability
steps.goal: Query calendars; normalize across time zones and working hours.

steps.name: propose_slots
steps.goal: Rank candidate slots by mutual convenience and preference config.

steps.name: negotiate
steps.goal: Send proposals and process replies, iterating until convergence.

steps.name: book_confirm
steps.goal: Create the event with room/link, send invites, and confirm to the requester.

outputs: Booked event with invites and location/link

title: OKR Tracking
summary: Automates the OKR cadence: pulls key-result metrics from source systems, collects qualitative updates from owners, scores each KR with an on-track/at-risk/off-track call and a stated reason, and drafts the check-in narrative — turning update-chasing into a review meeting that starts from data.
review_rationale: Owners confirm their KR scores before the narrative is published to leadership.

steps.name: pull_metrics
steps.goal: Fetch current values for every measurable KR from source systems.

steps.name: collect_updates
steps.goal: Request and gather qualitative updates from KR owners in parallel.

steps.name: score_krs
steps.goal: Score each KR with confidence and a cited data source.

steps.name: draft_narrative
steps.goal: Compose the check-in summary: wins, risks, asks, and trend deltas.

steps.name: publish
steps.goal: Distribute after owner confirmation and archive the scoring snapshot.

success_metrics: % KRs scored from live data (vs. self-report)
Forecast accuracy of at-risk calls at quarter end

title: Vendor Management
summary: Keeps the vendor lifecycle honest: runs onboarding due-diligence checks, audits the document set for gaps (MSA, DPA, insurance certificates, SOWs), monitors renewal and expiry dates across the portfolio, and raises alerts with enough lead time to actually negotiate rather than auto-renew.
review_rationale: Alerts and gap reports are automatic; any communication to a vendor requires approval.

steps.name: intake_vendor
steps.goal: Register the vendor and classify criticality and data access level.

steps.name: due_diligence
steps.goal: Run checklist verifications: registration, sanctions, security posture.

steps.name: doc_gap_analysis
steps.goal: Audit the contract set against required documents for the vendor's tier.

steps.name: monitor_renewals
steps.goal: Track expiry dates portfolio-wide and maintain the alert ladder.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Approve renewal alerts and the negotiate/renew/replace call before they go to vendor owners.

steps.name: alert_and_recommend
steps.goal: Issue renewal alerts with a negotiate/renew/replace recommendation.

title: Brand Voice Consistency
summary: Audits content against your brand guidelines — voice attributes, terminology, claims rules, formatting — scores each piece, flags deviations with severity and the specific guideline violated, and rewrites flagged passages while preserving meaning. Works as a pre-publish gate or a batch audit over existing content.
review_rationale: Rewrites are suggestions; authors accept or reject each with one click.

steps.name: load_guidelines
steps.goal: Parse the guidelines into checkable rules: voice, terms, claims, format.

steps.name: score_content
steps.goal: Evaluate the content against each rule category.

steps.name: flag_deviations
steps.goal: Emit findings with severity, location, and the cited guideline.

steps.name: rewrite_flagged
steps.goal: Rewrite flagged passages minimally, preserving meaning and facts.

steps.name: verify_rewrite
steps.goal: Reflect: confirm rewrites now pass and introduced no meaning drift.

inputs: Content to audit (single piece or corpus)
success_metrics: Deviation catch rate vs. human editor

title: Landing Page Generator
summary: Converts a campaign brief into a complete landing page: distills the value proposition, writes each section's copy (hero, benefits, social proof, FAQ, CTA), critiques the draft against conversion principles — clarity, single CTA, objection handling — and assembles clean HTML or markdown ready for the site.
review_rationale: Marketing approves before anything deploys; claims must trace to approved sources.

steps.name: intake_brief
steps.goal: Extract offer, audience, objections, and the single conversion goal.

steps.name: distill_value_prop
steps.goal: Write the core value proposition and message hierarchy.

steps.name: write_sections
steps.goal: Draft hero, benefits, proof, FAQ, and CTA sections.

steps.name: conversion_critique
steps.goal: Audit against the conversion checklist; revise flagged sections.

steps.name: assemble_page
steps.goal: Render the final page structure with copy in place.

steps.name: emit_variants
steps.goal: Produce headline/CTA variants for A/B testing.

success_metrics: Time from brief to review-ready page

title: Newsletter Generator
summary: Assembles a recurring newsletter: gathers candidate items from configured sources, ranks them for the audience, summarizes each in the newsletter's voice, composes the issue with intro and through-lines, and applies a final tone pass so the issue reads written, not aggregated.
review_rationale: The editor approves each issue before send; sources are always linked.

steps.name: gather_items
steps.goal: Collect candidate items from all sources since the last issue.

steps.name: rank_items
steps.goal: Score for audience relevance using profile and click history.

steps.name: summarize_items
steps.goal: Write each selected item's blurb in the newsletter voice, in parallel.

steps.name: compose_issue
steps.goal: Assemble intro, sections, and transitions per the template.

steps.name: tone_pass
steps.goal: Edit the full issue for a single coherent voice.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Deliver to the editor for approval and send.

inputs: Content sources (feeds, saved links, internal posts)
Audience profile and past click data
success_metrics: Open and click rates vs. list baseline

title: SEO Content Pipeline
summary: Takes a target keyword from brief to publishable draft: builds the content brief from search-intent analysis, outlines against what currently ranks, drafts the article, then runs an SEO critique pass — coverage, structure, internal links, metadata — and revises until the checklist passes.
review_rationale: An editor approves before publish; facts and claims are flagged for verification.

steps.name: build_brief
steps.goal: Analyze search intent and ranking content; define angle, scope, and structure.

steps.name: outline
steps.goal: Draft the outline covering intent gaps competitors miss.

steps.name: write_draft
steps.goal: Write the full draft per outline and style guide.

steps.name: seo_critique
steps.goal: Audit against the SEO checklist: coverage, headings, links, metadata.

steps.name: revise
steps.goal: Apply critique items; loop until the checklist passes or cap hits.

steps.name: package
steps.goal: Emit final draft, meta title/description, and link suggestions for editorial review.

title: Social Media Manager
summary: Plans a content calendar against campaign goals, generates channel-native variants of each post (a thread is not a caption is not a LinkedIn essay), runs brand checks, queues everything for approval, schedules the approved set, and reports engagement back into next cycle's planning.
review_rationale: All posts are approved before scheduling; replies/engagement are drafted, never auto-sent.

steps.name: plan_calendar
steps.goal: Map themes and goals onto a dated calendar with per-channel cadence.

steps.name: generate_variants
steps.goal: Create native variants per channel concurrently for each calendar slot.

steps.name: brand_check
steps.goal: Screen every variant against brand voice and claim rules.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Queue the batch for marketing approval with calendar context.

steps.name: schedule
steps.goal: Schedule approved posts via the publishing tool.

steps.name: analyze_engagement
steps.goal: Collect performance data and summarize learnings for the next cycle.

success_metrics: Engagement rate per channel vs. baseline

title: Churn Prediction & Intervention
summary: Assembles engagement, support, billing, and product-usage signals per account, scores churn risk, explains the *drivers* behind each at-risk score in plain language, selects an appropriate intervention from the playbook, and routes it to the owning CSM — because a risk score without a reason and a next step is just anxiety.
review_rationale: Interventions are recommendations to the CSM; customer-facing actions are human-executed.

steps.name: assemble_signals
steps.goal: Join usage, support, billing, and relationship signals per account.

steps.name: score_risk
steps.goal: Compute churn risk via the model or rubric; calibrate against history.

steps.name: explain_drivers
steps.goal: Identify and narrate the top drivers behind each at-risk score.

steps.name: select_intervention
steps.goal: Match drivers to playbook interventions with expected impact.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Approve the account brief and intervention before it is delivered to the owning CSM.

steps.name: route_csm
steps.goal: Deliver the account brief and recommendation to the owning CSM.

title: Feedback Analysis
summary: Aggregates feedback from reviews, NPS verbatims, support tickets, and social mentions, clusters it into themes, quantifies each theme's frequency and sentiment trend, and produces a report that connects themes to concrete product areas — turning ten thousand fragments into a ranked list of things to fix.
review_rationale: The report is decision input for product; no automated actions are taken.

steps.name: collect_feedback
steps.goal: Pull new feedback from all connected sources; dedupe cross-postings.

steps.name: normalize
steps.goal: Strip PII, standardize format, attach source and date metadata.

steps.name: cluster_themes
steps.goal: Group items into themes in parallel batches; map to product areas.

steps.name: quantify
steps.goal: Count frequency, compute sentiment, and calculate trend vs. baseline.

steps.name: compose_report
steps.goal: Rank themes and write the report with representative verbatims.

outputs: Ranked issues report with representative quotes
success_metrics: Coverage (% feedback assigned to a theme)

title: Lead Qualification
summary: Scores inbound leads while they're still warm: enriches each with firmographic and technographic data, scores fit against your ICP and intent from behavior signals, routes qualified leads to the right rep with a context brief, and logs everything to the CRM with the scoring rationale attached.
review_rationale: Routing is automatic; the score rationale is visible and contestable by reps in the CRM.

steps.name: capture_lead
steps.goal: Ingest the lead and dedupe against existing CRM contacts and accounts.

steps.name: enrich
steps.goal: Pull firmographic, technographic, and role data from enrichment sources.

steps.name: score_fit
steps.goal: Score against the ICP rubric with an explicit factor-by-factor rationale.

steps.name: score_intent
steps.goal: Rate buying intent from behavior: pages viewed, content, recency, frequency.

steps.name: route_and_brief
steps.goal: Route by score band; give the rep a one-paragraph context brief.

steps.name: log_crm
steps.goal: Write scores, rationale, and routing decision back to the CRM.

title: Personalized Outreach
summary: Researches each prospect across public signals — role, company news, tech stack, recent posts — selects a relevance angle, drafts genuinely personalized outreach, and runs a critique pass that rejects anything template-flavored before a human approves the send. Personalization here means 'shows work', not 'mail-merged first name'.
review_rationale: Every outbound message is human-approved before send; no autonomous sending.

steps.name: research_prospect
steps.goal: Gather role, company, news, and activity signals in parallel per prospect.

steps.name: select_angle
steps.goal: Choose the single most relevant hook connecting their context to your value.

steps.name: draft_sequence
steps.goal: Write the sequence: opener, follow-ups, and break-up note.

steps.name: critique_personalization
steps.goal: Reject drafts lacking specific, verifiable prospect facts; revise.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Queue for rep approval with the research brief attached.

steps.name: schedule_send
steps.goal: Schedule approved sequences and track engagement.

title: Support Ticket Triage
summary: Classifies every inbound ticket by product area and issue type, assigns priority from impact signals, checks for duplicates and known issues before a human ever reads it, routes to the owning queue, and drafts a first response — so agents open tickets that are labeled, prioritized, and half-answered.
review_rationale: Drafted responses are suggestions in the agent console; P1 classifications page a human.

steps.name: ingest_ticket
steps.goal: Normalize the ticket and extract product area, symptoms, and customer tier.

steps.name: check_known_issues
steps.goal: Search known issues and open incidents; link matches immediately.

steps.name: classify_priority
steps.goal: Score priority from impact, scope, tier, and sentiment signals.

steps.name: route_queue
steps.goal: Assign to the owning queue per the ownership map; page on P1.

steps.name: draft_response
steps.goal: Draft a first response grounded in KB articles, queued for agent review.

title: Anomaly Detection & Explanation
summary: Watches metric streams, detects anomalies with statistical methods (deterministic, cheap, and honest about uncertainty), then applies the model where it adds value: correlating the anomaly with deploys, campaigns, and seasonality to produce a ranked explanation — and deciding whether anyone should actually be woken up.
review_rationale: Alerts route to on-call with the explanation attached; suppression rules are human-owned.

steps.name: ingest_metrics
steps.goal: Pull metric windows and maintain baseline models per series.

steps.name: detect_statistical
steps.goal: Run detection (STL residuals, EWMA, or configured method) and score deviations.

steps.name: contextualize
steps.goal: Join anomalies against deploy, campaign, and seasonal calendars.

steps.name: explain
steps.goal: Draft ranked explanations citing the correlated evidence.

steps.name: critique_explanation
steps.goal: Reflect: does the evidence actually support the top explanation? Demote if not.

steps.name: route_alert
steps.goal: Send actionable alerts to the right owner; log suppressed ones with reasons.

title: Budget Variance Analysis
summary: Automates the monthly variance ritual: loads actuals and budget, computes variances at every rollup level, drills into significant deltas to identify the driving line items and transactions, and drafts the variance commentary that finance currently reverse-engineers by hand at close.
review_rationale: Finance reviews commentary before distribution; materiality thresholds are config, not vibes.

steps.name: load_data
steps.goal: Import actuals and budget; align periods, currencies, and hierarchies.

steps.name: compute_variances
steps.goal: Calculate absolute and percentage variances across every rollup.

steps.name: identify_material
steps.goal: Apply materiality thresholds to select variances worth explaining.

steps.name: drill_drivers
steps.goal: Trace each material variance to driving line items and transactions.

steps.name: draft_commentary
steps.goal: Write per-variance commentary citing the identified drivers.

steps.name: package_report
steps.goal: Assemble the variance report for finance review and distribution.

inputs: Budget/forecast by period and cost center
outputs: Variance table at all rollup levels

title: Dashboard Generation
summary: Goes from 'we need a dashboard for X' to a working artifact: profiles the available data, plans a layout matched to the audience's questions, generates and validates the queries, builds the charts, and assembles a self-contained dashboard — with a QA pass that checks every displayed number against a direct query.
review_rationale: The data owner approves the metric definitions before the dashboard is shared.

steps.name: profile_data
steps.goal: Inspect schemas, freshness, and quality of candidate tables.

steps.name: plan_layout
steps.goal: Map audience questions to a KPI/chart layout; get owner sign-off on definitions.

steps.name: generate_queries
steps.goal: Write and validate the query per panel against the warehouse.

steps.name: build_charts
steps.goal: Render charts with correct types, scales, and annotations.

steps.name: assemble
steps.goal: Compose panels into the dashboard with filters and drill-downs.

steps.name: qa_numbers
steps.goal: Re-verify every displayed figure with an independent direct query.

success_metrics: QA pass rate on displayed numbers (target 100%)

title: Financial Statement Analysis (10-Q / 10-K)
summary: Ingests a 10-Q or 10-K filing, extracts the financial statements and MD&A, runs parallel analyses over the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, and management discussion, computes the standard ratio set with period-over-period deltas, and synthesizes an analyst-style memo — then fact-checks every number in the memo against the extracted tables.
review_rationale: An analyst reviews the memo before it informs any decision; numbers carry source citations.

steps.name: fetch_filing
steps.goal: Retrieve the filing and identify statement and MD&A sections.

steps.name: extract_statements
steps.goal: Parse income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow into structured tables.

steps.name: parallel_analyses
steps.goal: Analyze each statement and the MD&A concurrently for trends and anomalies.

steps.name: compute_ratios
steps.goal: Calculate liquidity, leverage, profitability, and efficiency ratios with deltas.

steps.name: synthesize_memo
steps.goal: Draft the memo: thesis, supporting evidence, risks, open questions.

steps.name: fact_check
steps.goal: Verify every figure in the memo against extracted tables; correct or flag.

title: Forecasting
summary: Produces forecasts with honest uncertainty: prepares the series, selects and fits candidate models, backtests them against held-out history, generates prediction intervals, and writes a narrative that states assumptions and breakpoints explicitly — because a number without its assumptions is a trap.
review_rationale: A domain owner reviews assumptions and the narrative before the forecast enters planning.

steps.name: prepare_data
steps.goal: Clean the series: outliers, calendar effects, structural breaks.

steps.name: select_models
steps.goal: Choose candidates fit to the series' shape (ETS, ARIMA, gradient boosting).

steps.name: fit_backtest
steps.goal: Fit candidates and evaluate on rolling holdouts against naive baselines.

steps.name: generate_intervals
steps.goal: Produce point forecasts with calibrated prediction intervals.

steps.name: write_narrative
steps.goal: Draft the story: drivers, assumptions, risks, and breakpoints.

steps.name: review_assumptions
steps.goal: Reflect on assumption fragility; flag which future events would invalidate the forecast.

title: Portfolio Monitoring
summary: Monitors an investment portfolio's positions, exposures, and relevant news in parallel: computes concentration and drawdown against policy thresholds, scans filings and headlines for held names, and produces a daily digest that separates 'informational' from 'needs attention'. Strictly decision support — it surfaces, it never trades.
review_rationale: All threshold-breach flags route to the owner; the system has no execution pathway.

steps.name: fetch_positions
steps.goal: Load current positions and reconcile against the prior snapshot.

steps.name: parallel_scan
steps.goal: Concurrently compute exposures, pull prices, and scan news/filings for held names.

steps.name: check_thresholds
steps.goal: Evaluate concentration, drawdown, and volatility against policy limits.

steps.name: flag_events
steps.goal: Rank news and breaches by materiality to the portfolio.

steps.name: compose_digest
steps.goal: Produce the daily digest: attention items first, informational after.

outputs: News digest scoped to held names
success_metrics: Coverage of held names in news scan

title: Bug Triage
summary: Takes raw bug reports from any channel, checks for duplicates against the existing tracker, assesses severity and reproducibility, and routes each issue to the owning team with a cleaned-up, actionable ticket. The goal: no engineer ever opens a ticket that says 'it doesn't work'.
review_rationale: Sev-1 classifications page a human for confirmation; routine routing is automatic.

steps.name: ingest_report
steps.goal: Normalize the report: extract symptoms, environment, and any repro info.

steps.name: dedupe_check
steps.goal: Search the tracker for existing matching issues; link instead of filing if found.

steps.name: assess_severity
steps.goal: Score severity and reproducibility from impact, scope, and evidence.

steps.name: enrich_ticket
steps.goal: Rewrite the report as an actionable ticket: repro steps, expected vs. actual.

steps.name: route_assign
steps.goal: Assign to the owning team from the ownership map; page a human for sev-1.

steps.name: notify
steps.goal: Confirm to the reporter with the ticket link and severity rationale.

success_metrics: Median time from report to assigned ticket

title: Code Migration
summary: Plans and executes large migrations — framework upgrades, language ports, API deprecations — by inventorying every affected site, batching them into safe units, translating each batch, running tests, and tracking progress until the old pattern count hits zero. Built for migrations too big for one heroic PR.
review_rationale: Humans review each batch PR; the agent never merges. Batch size shrinks automatically after failures.

steps.name: inventory
steps.goal: Find every occurrence of the source pattern; record in the progress ledger.

steps.name: plan_batches
steps.goal: Group occurrences into low-risk batches with explicit dependency ordering.

steps.name: translate_batch
steps.goal: Apply the transformation to one batch; keep changes mechanical.

steps.name: run_tests
steps.goal: Run affected tests; on failure, self-repair once, then shrink the batch and retry.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Open the batch PR for human review with before/after summaries.

steps.name: update_ledger
steps.goal: Mark completed occurrences and publish the burndown.

outputs: Batched migration PRs with test results
success_metrics: Zero-regression test pass rate per batch

title: Code Review Agent
summary: Reviews pull requests through parallel specialist lenses — security, performance, correctness, readability — then deduplicates, ranks by severity, and self-checks findings against the diff before posting comments. It aims to catch the mechanical 80% so human reviewers spend attention on design.
review_rationale: Findings post as comments only; a human always merges. Severity-critical findings page a human.

steps.name: fetch_diff
steps.goal: Pull the PR diff, changed-file context, and repository conventions.

steps.name: parallel_lenses
steps.goal: Run security, performance, correctness, and readability reviews concurrently.

steps.name: aggregate
steps.goal: Merge lens findings, dedupe overlapping comments, rank by severity.

steps.name: self_check
steps.goal: Re-verify each finding against the actual diff; drop unsupported claims.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Approve the surviving findings before they post as comments on the pull request.

steps.name: post_comments
steps.goal: Post surviving comments with severity labels and suggested fixes.

outputs: Ranked review comments with file/line anchors
success_metrics: Human review time saved per PR

title: Deployment Orchestrator
summary: Drives a gated production deployment: preflight verification (CI, approvals, migrations, feature flags), a canary rollout with automated health monitoring against predefined rollback triggers, and promotion or rollback with a full decision log. The rollback criteria are written down *before* the deploy, when everyone is still calm.
review_rationale: Human gate before deploy start and before canary promotion; rollback is automatic on triggers.

steps.name: preflight_checks
steps.goal: Verify CI status, approvals, migration readiness, and flag states.

steps.name: plan_rollout
steps.goal: Produce the rollout plan: canary size, health metrics, rollback triggers.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Release owner approves the plan and authorizes the deploy.

steps.name: deploy_canary
steps.goal: Ship to the canary slice and begin structured health monitoring.

steps.name: monitor_health
steps.goal: Watch error rates, latency, and saturation against trigger thresholds.

steps.name: promote_or_rollback
steps.goal: On human approval promote; on tripped triggers roll back automatically and report.

success_metrics: Mean time to rollback on bad deploys

title: Documentation Generator
summary: Indexes a codebase, plans a documentation structure appropriate to its shape (API reference, guides, architecture notes), generates each section grounded in the actual code, and verifies that examples compile and cross-references resolve. Docs drift is treated as a bug: reruns diff against existing docs.
review_rationale: A maintainer approves the doc plan and reviews generated pages before merge.

steps.name: index_code
steps.goal: Parse the repo: modules, public APIs, entry points, existing docs.

steps.name: plan_structure
steps.goal: Propose a doc tree with per-page scope; get maintainer sign-off.

steps.name: generate_sections
steps.goal: Write each page grounded in the indexed code, with examples.

steps.name: verify_examples
steps.goal: Execute every example; fix or flag failures before proceeding.

steps.name: cross_link
steps.goal: Resolve internal links and produce the navigation structure.

steps.name: emit_drift_report
steps.goal: On reruns, diff generated docs against current pages and summarize drift.

success_metrics: Maintainer edit rate on generated pages

title: Refactoring Assistant
summary: Identifies code smells, plans a refactor as a sequence of small, independently safe transformations, and applies them one at a time — running the test suite after every step and stopping the moment anything breaks. Big-bang refactors are structurally impossible by design.
review_rationale: A developer approves the refactor plan and reviews the final diff; no direct pushes.

steps.name: identify_smells
steps.goal: Scan the target for smells: duplication, god functions, tangled deps.

steps.name: plan_refactor
steps.goal: Sequence small safe transformations, each with a stated invariant.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Present the plan with risk notes for developer sign-off.

steps.name: apply_step
steps.goal: Apply one transformation; keep the diff minimal and mechanical.

steps.name: run_tests
steps.goal: Run the suite; on red, revert the step and replan instead of patching forward.

steps.name: summarize
steps.goal: Produce the final diff summary and metrics delta for review.

success_metrics: Test suite green rate across steps (target 100%)

title: Security Scan & Triage
summary: Runs static analyzers and dependency audits in parallel, normalizes their findings, then uses the model for what scanners cannot do: triaging exploitability in the context of *this* codebase, collapsing duplicates, and writing remediation guidance an engineer can act on directly.
review_rationale: A security engineer reviews all high/critical triage decisions and any downgrade.

steps.name: run_scanners
steps.goal: Execute SAST, dependency, and secret scanners concurrently.

steps.name: normalize
steps.goal: Map all findings to one schema: location, class, raw severity, evidence.

steps.name: triage_findings
steps.goal: Assess exploitability in deployment context; dedupe and re-rank.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Security engineer reviews rankings and approves downgrades.

steps.name: create_tickets
steps.goal: File remediation tickets with concrete fix guidance and owners.

steps.name: track_recurrence
steps.goal: Compare against prior runs; flag regressions and recurring classes.

success_metrics: Mean time from scan to ticketed remediation
Recurrence rate of previously fixed finding classes

title: Technical Debt Tracker
summary: Continuously inventories technical debt — TODO/FIXME mining, complexity hotspots, outdated dependencies, low-coverage modules — then estimates each item's carrying cost and remediation effort to produce a prioritized, defensible paydown backlog. Debt stops being folklore and becomes a ranked list with numbers attached.
review_rationale: The ranked backlog is a proposal; engineering leads own final prioritization.

steps.name: scan_repo
steps.goal: Run parallel scans: marker mining, complexity metrics, dep freshness, coverage.

steps.name: classify_debt
steps.goal: Categorize items: design, test, dependency, documentation, tooling.

steps.name: estimate_costs
steps.goal: Estimate remediation effort and carrying cost (interest) per item.

steps.name: prioritize
steps.goal: Rank by interest-to-effort ratio, boosted by incident correlation.

steps.name: report
steps.goal: Publish the backlog and quarterly trend deltas to the engineering channel.

outputs: Ranked paydown backlog with effort/interest estimates

title: Test Generation
summary: Analyzes coverage gaps, plans test cases that target untested branches and edge conditions, generates the tests, runs them, and repairs its own failures — a closed loop anchored by the test runner, the one critic that cannot be argued with.
review_rationale: A developer reviews generated tests before merge; assertion quality is human-audited.

steps.name: analyze_coverage
steps.goal: Run coverage tooling and identify untested functions and branches.

steps.name: plan_cases
steps.goal: For each gap, derive test cases from the spec: happy path, edges, error paths.

steps.name: generate_tests
steps.goal: Write tests in the project's framework and style conventions.

steps.name: run_suite
steps.goal: Execute the new tests; separate genuine bugs from broken tests.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Approve which failures are real bugs before any are filed as tickets.

steps.name: repair_failures
steps.goal: Fix broken generated tests; file discovered real bugs as tickets.

steps.name: report
steps.goal: Emit the coverage delta and a summary of cases added and bugs found.

outputs: List of discovered bugs (tests that fail correctly)
success_metrics: % generated tests kept after human review

title: Capacity Planning
summary: Forecasts infrastructure needs before they become incidents or invoices: collects utilization across compute, storage, and network, models growth from trends and known business events, simulates scenarios (launch spikes, regional failover, organic growth), and recommends provisioning with explicit lead times and costs.
review_rationale: Provisioning recommendations are reviewed by infrastructure leadership before purchase.

steps.name: collect_utilization
steps.goal: Aggregate utilization across compute, storage, network, and services.

steps.name: model_growth
steps.goal: Fit growth trends; overlay known business events.

steps.name: simulate_scenarios
steps.goal: Run structured what-if scenarios against the architecture topology.

steps.name: identify_gaps
steps.goal: Find where projected demand crosses capacity within lead-time windows.

steps.name: recommend_provisioning
steps.goal: Draft the provisioning plan with costs, lead times, and triggers.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Approve the provisioning plan and its stated assumptions before publication to leadership.

steps.name: report
steps.goal: Publish the plan for leadership review with assumptions stated.

outputs: Provisioning plan with lead times and costs

title: Cloud Cost Optimization
summary: Continuously mines billing and utilization data for waste — idle resources, oversized instances, unattached volumes, commitment gaps — sizes each opportunity in dollars, risk-checks recommendations against workload patterns so 'savings' don't cause outages, files tickets with owners, and tracks realized (not estimated) savings over time.
review_rationale: Recommendations become tickets; resource changes are executed by owning teams, not the agent.

steps.name: ingest_billing
steps.goal: Load billing and utilization data; normalize across accounts.

steps.name: detect_waste
steps.goal: Scan for idle, oversized, unattached, and uncommitted spend in parallel.

steps.name: size_opportunities
steps.goal: Quantify each finding in monthly dollars with confidence.

steps.name: risk_check
steps.goal: Validate against long-window load patterns and dependencies.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Approve each recommendation, its dollar impact and its rollback note before tickets are filed.

steps.name: create_tickets
steps.goal: File recommendations with owners, dollar impact, and rollback notes.

steps.name: track_savings
steps.goal: Compare subsequent billing to baseline; report realized savings.

title: Incident Response
summary: Accelerates the human-led incident loop: triages alerts into severity calls, gathers diagnostics across logs, metrics, traces, and recent deploys in parallel, generates ranked root-cause hypotheses with supporting evidence, proposes remediations behind a human gate, and drafts the postmortem from the recorded timeline while memories are still accurate.
review_rationale: Severity calls above SEV-3 and all remediation actions require on-call approval.

steps.name: triage_alert
steps.goal: Classify the alert: severity, blast radius, affected services.

steps.name: gather_diagnostics
steps.goal: Pull logs, metrics, traces, and recent changes concurrently.

steps.name: hypothesize_causes
steps.goal: Rank root-cause hypotheses, each with its supporting evidence.

steps.name: propose_remediation
steps.goal: Match hypotheses to runbook actions with risk notes.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: On-call approves the remediation before any execution.

steps.name: execute_monitored
steps.goal: Apply the approved action; watch recovery metrics.

steps.name: draft_postmortem
steps.goal: Assemble the timeline, decisions, and follow-ups into a postmortem draft.

success_metrics: Hypothesis hit rate (top-3 contains root cause)

title: Log Analysis
summary: Turns log volume into signal: parses and normalizes heterogeneous logs, detects emerging error patterns and rare-event signatures, correlates patterns with deploys and incidents, summarizes what a human should look at and why, and proposes new alert rules for patterns that preceded past incidents — closing the loop between analysis and prevention.
review_rationale: Proposed alert rules require SRE approval before deployment; summaries are informational.

steps.name: ingest_logs
steps.goal: Pull log windows across services; apply parsing schemas in parallel.

steps.name: normalize
steps.goal: Extract structured events: service, level, signature, context.

steps.name: detect_patterns
steps.goal: Cluster signatures; score by novelty, growth rate, and severity.

steps.name: correlate
steps.goal: Join top patterns against deploys and incident history.

steps.name: summarize_findings
steps.goal: Write the investigation summary: what, where, evidence, suggested owner.

steps.name: propose_alert_rules
steps.goal: Draft alert rules for validated precursors, with backtest support.

outputs: Proposed alert rules with backtest evidence
success_metrics: Incident precursors caught before alerting did

title: Calendar, Email & Docs Agent
summary: A unified personal-operations agent that reads your calendar, inbox, and documents through tool calls, then drafts replies, schedules meetings, and files or retrieves documents on request. It turns three context-switching chores into one conversational surface, with every outbound action gated behind your approval.
review_rationale: Outbound emails, calendar changes, and document edits require approval before execution.

steps.name: ingest_request
steps.goal: Parse the user's request and extract the intent, entities, and constraints.

steps.name: route_intent
steps.goal: Classify the request as calendar, email, docs, or mixed, and pick the tool plan.

steps.name: gather_context
steps.goal: Pull the relevant threads, events, and documents via read-only tool calls.

steps.name: draft_action
steps.goal: Compose the email draft, event proposal, or document operation.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Present the drafted action with full context for approval.

steps.name: execute
steps.goal: Perform the approved action via tool calls and log the result.

success_metrics: % of requests completed without human correction
Time saved per week vs. manual handling

title: Document Workflow (Draft → Review → Publish)
summary: Manages a document through its lifecycle: intake of the request, structured drafting, an automated self-critique pass, human review with tracked feedback, revision, and publication to the destination system. It standardizes the path every important document should take but rarely does.
review_rationale: A human approves every document before publication; the agent never publishes autonomously.

steps.name: intake
steps.goal: Capture the document request: type, audience, purpose, sources, deadline.

steps.name: draft
steps.goal: Produce a structured first draft from the sources and the applicable template.

steps.name: self_critique
steps.goal: Critique the draft against the style guide and the request; revise once.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Route the improved draft to the named reviewer and collect feedback.

steps.name: revise
steps.goal: Apply reviewer feedback faithfully; flag any conflicting instructions.

steps.name: publish
steps.goal: Publish to the destination system and record the final version.

outputs: Reviewed, approved document in the target format

title: Focus Session (Pomodoro Orchestrator)
summary: Runs structured deep-work sessions: plans the block against your task list, starts Pomodoro timers, triages interruptions as they arrive (defer, delegate, or break protocol for true emergencies), and closes with a logged retrospective. The agent's job is defending the block, not just timing it.
review_rationale: Fully automated; interruption escalation thresholds are user-configured.

steps.name: plan_session
steps.goal: Pick the session's tasks from the priority list and set the block structure.

steps.name: start_timer
steps.goal: Begin the work interval; silence non-critical notification channels.

steps.name: triage_interruptions
steps.goal: Classify each incoming interruption: defer, quick-answer at break, or escalate.

steps.name: log_outcome
steps.goal: At session end, record work completed and interruption dispositions.

steps.name: retrospective
steps.goal: Summarize the session and suggest one adjustment for the next block.

title: Habit Tracking & Coaching
summary: Tracks habit completions from lightweight check-ins, computes streaks and adherence trends, and — the agentic part — analyzes *why* habits slip (day-of-week patterns, conflicting events, streak-break triggers) and adjusts its nudges accordingly. A tracker records; this coaches.
review_rationale: Fully automated; the user is the feedback loop.

steps.name: log_ingest
steps.goal: Record check-ins and backfill misses from the check-in channel.

steps.name: compute_streaks
steps.goal: Update streaks, adherence rates, and rolling trends per habit.

steps.name: analyze_patterns
steps.goal: Find slip patterns: days, contexts, and events that precede misses.

steps.name: generate_nudges
steps.goal: Draft targeted nudges timed and phrased to the user's observed patterns.

steps.name: weekly_review
steps.goal: Reflect on nudge effectiveness and adjust cadence and tone.

title: Meeting Intelligence
summary: Turns raw meeting transcripts into a decision log, an action-item list with owners and due dates, and a shareable summary — then routes each artifact to the people who need it. Nothing said in a meeting should die in the recording.
review_rationale: Spot-check summaries weekly; action items with external recipients get a send gate.

steps.name: ingest_transcript
steps.goal: Load the transcript, normalize speaker labels, and segment by topic.

steps.name: parallel_extract
steps.goal: Run summary, decision, and action-item extraction lenses concurrently.

steps.name: synthesize
steps.goal: Merge lens outputs, resolve owner names against the attendee list, dedupe items.

steps.name: format_outputs
steps.goal: Render the summary, decision log, and task list in their target formats.

steps.name: distribute
steps.goal: Send artifacts to attendees and push action items to the task tracker.

success_metrics: Action-item capture rate vs. human note-taker
Time from meeting end to distribution (target < 10 min)

title: Note Synthesis
summary: Ingests scattered notes — meeting scribbles, highlights, voice memos, browser clips — clusters them by theme, and synthesizes each cluster into a clean, linked knowledge page. It converts note-taking (cheap) into knowledge-building (valuable) without the weekly manual review you keep not doing.
review_rationale: Synthesized pages are drafts in the notes app; originals are never modified or deleted.

steps.name: gather_notes
steps.goal: Collect new notes since the last run and normalize formats.

steps.name: cluster_themes
steps.goal: Group notes by topic using embeddings or LLM classification.

steps.name: synthesize_clusters
steps.goal: Summarize each cluster into a coherent page, in parallel, citing source notes.

steps.name: cross_link
steps.goal: Link new pages to existing knowledge-base pages and propose tags.

steps.name: publish_digest
steps.goal: Write pages as drafts and produce a run digest with an orphan-note list.

outputs: Themed synthesis pages with source links
success_metrics: % of notes reachable from a synthesis page
Synthesis factual-error rate on spot checks

title: Personal Assistant over Messaging
summary: A single-agent assistant that lives where you already are — Slack, Telegram, or SMS — and handles quick tasks: reminders, lookups, short research, list-keeping. Low ceremony by design: the value is response speed and zero app-switching.
review_rationale: Read-only actions run free; anything that messages third parties requires approval.

steps.name: receive_message
steps.goal: Accept the inbound message and load recent conversation context.

steps.name: classify
steps.goal: Determine request type: reminder, lookup, list op, small talk, or out-of-scope.

steps.name: execute_action
steps.goal: Run the matching tool call or compose the informational answer.

steps.name: respond
steps.goal: Reply in the channel, concise by default, with links to anything created.

steps.name: log_interaction
steps.goal: Record the request, action, and outcome for weekly quality review.

inputs: Inbound messages from the chat platform

title: Task Prioritization (Eisenhower Matrix)
summary: Collects tasks from your trackers and inbox, enriches each with deadline and stakeholder context, and places it in the Eisenhower matrix — urgent/important quadrants — then proposes a concrete daily plan: do, schedule, delegate, or drop. The reflection pass challenges its own urgency calls, which is where most prioritization systems quietly fail.
review_rationale: The user confirms the daily plan; drops and delegations are proposals, never automatic.

steps.name: collect_tasks
steps.goal: Aggregate open tasks from all connected sources and dedupe.

steps.name: enrich
steps.goal: Attach deadlines, blockers, stakeholders, and effort estimates to each task.

steps.name: classify_quadrants
steps.goal: Score urgency and importance independently; place tasks in the matrix.

steps.name: critique_plan
steps.goal: Reflect: challenge urgency-inflated items and surface neglected Q2 work.

steps.name: propose_schedule
steps.goal: Emit a daily plan: do-now list, calendar blocks, delegations, drops.

success_metrics: User overrides per plan (target trending down)

title: Competitive Intelligence
summary: Tracks competitors continuously across pricing pages, release notes, job postings, filings, and press: collects signals in parallel per competitor, analyzes what changed and why it matters, maintains living battlecards, and alerts on material moves — the difference between intelligence and a pile of screenshots is the 'so what' analysis.
review_rationale: Battlecard updates auto-publish with change logs; material-move alerts are human-verified before broad distribution.

steps.name: plan_collection
steps.goal: Orchestrate the source list per competitor for this run.

steps.name: collect_signals
steps.goal: Scrape/fetch all mapped sources concurrently; snapshot everything.

steps.name: detect_deltas
steps.goal: Diff against prior snapshots; discard unchanged sources.

steps.name: analyze_changes
steps.goal: For each delta, assess what changed, why, and competitive implications.

steps.name: update_battlecards
steps.goal: Merge validated analysis into battlecards with change logs.

steps.name: alert_material
steps.goal: Route moves meeting materiality criteria for human verification and alert.

success_metrics: Detection lead time vs. team awareness

title: Market Sizing (TAM / SAM / SOM)
summary: Estimates market size the defensible way — twice: a top-down pass from industry reports and a bottom-up pass from customer counts and pricing, then reconciles the two, runs sensitivity analysis on the assumptions that drive the spread, and writes a memo where every number carries its source and its confidence.
review_rationale: Assumptions are reviewed by the requesting stakeholder before the memo circulates.

steps.name: define_market
steps.goal: Pin the market definition, segments, and geographic scope.

steps.name: topdown_estimate
steps.goal: Derive TAM from industry data; filter to SAM/SOM with explicit assumptions.

steps.name: bottomup_estimate
steps.goal: Build from target-customer counts × realistic pricing and penetration.

steps.name: reconcile
steps.goal: Compare approaches; investigate and document divergences.

steps.name: sensitivity_analysis
steps.goal: Vary the driving assumptions; report the ranges they produce.

steps.name: compose_memo
steps.goal: Write the memo with every figure sourced and confidence-labeled.

inputs: Industry reports and public data sources

title: News Aggregation & Summarization
summary: Monitors configured feeds and topics, deduplicates the same story across outlets, clusters coverage into events, summarizes each event with multi-source grounding, ranks by relevance to your interests, and delivers a briefing sized for its reading slot — five minutes should mean five minutes.
review_rationale: Fully automated delivery; source links accompany every summary for verification.

steps.name: fetch_sources
steps.goal: Pull new items from all feeds concurrently.

steps.name: dedupe_cluster
steps.goal: Group items covering the same underlying event across outlets.

steps.name: summarize_events
steps.goal: Summarize each cluster in parallel, grounded in all its sources.

steps.name: rank_relevance
steps.goal: Score events against the interest profile.

steps.name: compose_briefing
steps.goal: Assemble the briefing to the length budget, links included.

title: Patent Analysis
summary: Maps a patent landscape for a technology area: queries patent databases, clusters filings by claimed subject matter, analyzes claim scope and assignee activity, assesses proximity of your own concepts to existing claims, and produces a landscape report that tells R&D where the field is crowded and where it is open.
review_rationale: Patent counsel reviews all proximity assessments; no output constitutes a legal opinion.

steps.name: query_databases
steps.goal: Run keyword, classification, and citation searches across patent DBs.

steps.name: cluster_filings
steps.goal: Group results by claimed subject matter, in parallel batches.

steps.name: analyze_claims
steps.goal: Assess independent-claim scope and prosecution status per cluster.

steps.name: assess_proximity
steps.goal: Screen your concepts against clusters; flag close claims with reasoning.

steps.name: self_check
steps.goal: Verify flags cite actual claim language; strip anything resembling legal advice.

steps.name: human_approval
steps.goal: Deliver the report to patent counsel for review.

outputs: Clustered landscape map with assignee activity
success_metrics: Landscape recall vs. counsel benchmark search

title: Research Synthesis
summary: Builds a literature review from a research question: scopes the question into sub-questions, retrieves and screens the corpus, extracts structured findings from each source in parallel, synthesizes across sources — surfacing agreements, contradictions, and gaps — and verifies that every claim in the review traces to a specific source.
review_rationale: The researcher reviews the synthesis; the citation-check report ships alongside it.

steps.name: scope_question
steps.goal: Decompose the question into sub-questions and search strategies.

steps.name: retrieve_screen
steps.goal: Retrieve candidates and screen against inclusion criteria.

steps.name: extract_findings
steps.goal: Extract methods, findings, and limitations per source, in parallel.

steps.name: synthesize
steps.goal: Integrate across sources: agreements, contradictions, open gaps.

steps.name: verify_citations
steps.goal: Check every synthesis claim against its cited extraction; fix or flag.

steps.name: compose_review
steps.goal: Produce the final review with the citation-check report attached.

success_metrics: Corpus recall vs. expert reference list
